cases.name: Ball into bin
cases.description: Pick up the ball, carry it above the bin, release and verify it settles inside.

cases.name: Blocks into box
cases.description: Pick three Lego-like blocks from a group, one at a time, and put all of them in the box.

cases.name: Random blocks into box
cases.description: Collect six scattered, rotated blocks from a wider floor area into a movable physical box. G reshuffles.

cases.name: Camera search and collect
cases.description: Detect coloured floor bricks, pick them through the wrist camera, then visually locate the marked box before returning and releasing.

cases.name: Coloured distractors
cases.description: Level 3 distractors challenge for the unchanged RGB controller. Failure is an experimental result.

cases.name: Touching same-colour bricks
cases.description: Level 3 touching challenge for the unchanged RGB controller. Failure is an experimental result.

cases.name: Partially hidden bricks
cases.description: Level 3 occlusion challenge for the unchanged RGB controller. Failure is an experimental result.

cases.name: House search and collect
cases.description: Search a mapped apartment with the front camera, collect scattered bricks from all rooms, and return to a visually reacquired movable box.

cases.name: Stock landmark pickup and return
cases.description: Collect one RGB-detected brick, return by a stock YOLO furniture view, then visually reacquire the box and release.

cases.name: Stock landmarks: scattered room blocks
cases.description: Six rotated blocks spread beside dining-room furniture; stock furniture-view return is challenged by repeated trips and turns.

cases.name: Discover house and collect
cases.description: Build a local map from the wrist camera, find the six scattered bricks, and return them to a visually learned box without a supplied floorplan or coverage route.

cases.name: Find one brick and return
cases.description: Explore an unknown house, consume the first RGB brick sighting, then stop facing the freshly observed box. No grasp or drop.
